text: よく　ここまで　たどり　ついたな！

patterns.name: よく〜た
patterns.span: よく　ここまで　たどり　ついた
patterns.explanation: よく with a past verb shows the speaker is impressed that someone managed it. よく ここまで たどり ついた = 'well done making it this far'.

patterns.name: 〜な (exclamation)
patterns.explanation: な at the end shows the speaker is impressed or thinking aloud. たどり ついたな = 'you really made it, huh'.
